primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The ORR was estimated based on the number of participants who achieved an objective response (OR) (complete response \[CR\], complete cytogenetic remission \[CCR\], partial remission \[PR\], marrow response \[MR\], or clinical benefit \[CB\] performed by Principal Investigator according to the MDS/MPN International Working Group \[IWG\] criteria).
